oracleProvenance.basis: Published layout ABI 3 and the source behavior in experiments/AgentLang.OwningMailbox/owning-mailbox-sums.flow.
oracleProvenance.derivation: A String is an 8-byte header (UTF-16 unit count plus four reserved zero bytes), UTF-16LE content, and zero padding to an 8-byte extent. Chunk is a one-field record containing that standalone String encoding. Option and Result are an 8-byte little-endian tag followed by the active child's standalone encoding. State and Continuation are one-field records containing the complete inline sum encoding.
oracleProvenance.independentPreExecutionReview: Before any native execution, root review corrected the Z lifecycle State payload from 22 to 18 bytes and added the None-match empty-string literal (8 copied bytes) to the ERR resume formula. A second accounting review traced the final sequence: thirteen handler-dispatched lifecycle API calls, including the expected FAIL and retained-capacity failures, stage 168 bytes total; two malformed active-root attempts reject before handler dispatch, adding 0 staging bytes under RETURN and 16 under KEEP_ASSOCIATED because that policy stages the empty completion String before attached-root validation. A further required Error-arm round trip adds the second empty begin and resume call, yielding deep-copy total 872 bytes per policy. No native output was used.
oracleProvenance.layoutIndexes: The C runner receives layout indexes from the emitted bootstrap metadata, keyed by typeName and layoutIndex; the fixture contains no hardcoded descriptor index convention.

sourceDerivedTypeIds.typeIdRule: Int=1, Bool=2, Unit=3, nominal records sorted by source type name start at 4, String follows all nominal records.

activeResultTag.reason: Tag 2 is outside the two-case Result descriptor.

activeOptionStringLength.reason: The Some payload begins with its nested String header at byte 8; UINT32_MAX UTF-16 units exceeds its bounded root extent.

sum.activePayload: complete standalone child encoding immediately after tag

copyAccounting.scope: Exact API sequence per policy: Unicode init(A🙂), begin(δ), malformed active Result tag with empty completion, malformed active Option payload with empty completion, resume(FAIL), retry resume(NUL+🚀); Z init, begin(empty), resume(ERR), begin(empty) from Error(ERR), resume(empty) to exercise the Result.Error extraction arm; capacity init(empty), begin(empty), resume(1234567) rejected one byte short, retry resume(empty). The thirteen handler-dispatched lifecycle API calls, including expected FAIL and retained-capacity failures, stage 168 bytes. The two malformed-root attempts reject before handler dispatch: RETURN validates published bank roots before text staging, so totals 168; KEEP_ASSOCIATED stages the 8-byte empty completion before validating attached roots, totaling 184. Extraction, ordinary calls, descriptor transfer, and match views add no payload movement. Literal creation, explicit record/sum construction, and concatenation each contribute their full copied extent to deepCopyBytes.

formulaTerms.initializeWithStringExtentT: Chunk.new copies T + Result.Ok copies T + State.new copies (8 + T) = 3*T + 8
formulaTerms.beginSomeWithStringExtentT: empty-string condition literal 8 + Chunk.new T + Option.Some child copy T + Continuation.new copies (8 + T) = 3*T + 16
formulaTerms.beginNone: empty-string condition literal 8 + Option.None tag store 0 + Continuation.new copies 8 = 16
formulaTerms.resumeOkUnicode: FAIL literal 16 + ERR literal 16 + concat(base,pending) extent 16 + concat(combined,message) extent 24 + Chunk.new 24 + Result.Ok child copy 24 + State.new copies 32 = 152
formulaTerms.resumeErrorErr: None match empty-string literal 8 + FAIL literal 16 + ERR literal 16 + Result.Error copies message extent 16 + State.new copies result extent 24 = 80
formulaTerms.resumeHandlerFailureSomeUnicode: After Some extraction: FAIL comparison literal 16; execution stops before the ERR comparison or any output construction
formulaTerms.beginNoneAfterError: empty-string condition literal 8 + Option.None tag store 0 + Continuation.new copies 8 = 16
formulaTerms.resumeOkFromErrorAndNone: None match empty-string literal 8 + FAIL and ERR literals 32 + concat(ERR,empty) extent 16 + concat(ERR,empty) extent 16 + Chunk.new 16 + Result.Ok child copy 16 + State.new copies 24 = 128
formulaTerms.capacityResumeSevenUnits: None payload literal 8 + FAIL and ERR literals 32 + empty concat extent 8 + seven-unit concat extent 24 + Chunk.new 24 + Result.Ok child copy 24 + State.new copies 32 = 152
formulaTerms.capacityRetryEmpty: None payload literal 8 + FAIL and ERR literals 32 + two empty concat extents 16 + Chunk.new 8 + Result.Ok child copy 8 + State.new copies 16 = 88

requiredChecks: diagnostic, fast-reset, and trusted-generated host builds each run the sum lifecycle
RETURN and KEEP_ASSOCIATED both publish and resume nested nominal sum payloads
Some survives RETURN bank import and KEEP associated-root resume
Some/Ok, None/Error, Unicode, embedded NUL, and empty payload bytes match this fixture
the Error completion arm is extracted through an ordinary call on a second actual mailbox resume
FAIL occurs after both helper matches and preserves roots and pending token for retry
one-byte-short retained capacity preserves roots and pending token for retry
malformed active sum tag and active nested string payload are rejected with scanner output sentinels unchanged
malformed active tag and payload through mailbox APIs preserve pending roots and token in every profile
an invalid inactive Result alternative is rejected with scanner and controller output sentinels unchanged
ordinary calls and matches report zero payload moves
Layout ABI remains 3 and stack ABI remains 1
limitations: This is a bounded mailbox integration fixture for one nominal record payload closure, not new language or runtime architecture.
Copy counters report logical runtime-requested extents and are not hardware traffic measurements.
